title: Ledger Balance Bands for PracticePay Returned-Payment Fees
content:
**Rule.** The balance share of a PracticePay Patient Financing returned-payment fee reads the plan's ledger balance, which is the financed charge plus monthly interest, billed deferred interest, late fees, returned-payment fees and returned payments, less payments, provider refunds and waivers: a ledger balance below 1000.00 USD gives 0.8, a ledger balance of at least 1000.00 USD and below 3000.00 USD gives 0.9, and a ledger balance of 3000.00 USD or more gives 1.

| Ledger balance | Balance share |
|---|---|
| below 1000.00 | 0.8 |
| 1000.00 or more but below 3000.00 | 0.9 |
| 3000.00 or more | 1 |

*Hypothetical ledger.* Financed charge 2000.00, monthly interest 150.00, one late fee 30.00, one returned payment 100.00 with its fee 20.00, payments 1200.00, one waiver 30.00: ledger balance 2000.00 plus 150.00 plus 30.00 plus 100.00 plus 20.00, less 1200.00 and 30.00, that is 1070.00; share 0.9.
